doctrine.thesis: files are truth, chat is heat (STRATA_DROP_20261001.md: 'OUR record that stays (verkle chain, residual store, seed - files are truth) through THEIR engine that swaps'). Tonight's audit shows the truth leaking three named ways: cited primaries evaporate with sessions (division B sweep), founding texts invisible to the librarian (arXiv-token matching returned zero over 192 non-arXiv holdings), loose bytes in scratch staged into git.
doctrine.must_hold: Primaries of the estate's own laws: every verdict=LANDED carries a byte-hashed primary on a receipted shelf, audited in both directions. Founding texts the laws argue from (Turing 1936, Shannon 1948, EDVAC 1945, Watson 1928) sit in corpus shelves, not just as citations. One-line law: NO VERDICT=LANDED WITHOUT THE PRIMARY IN HOLDINGS (citation-resolution law extended from links to library).
doctrine.may_cite: Live web at claim time: a URL is a promise, not a holding. Cite freely; the claim graduates to LANDED only when the primary is pulled, hashed, and text-confirmed (LIVENESS IS NOT TRUTH). Transport discipline: curl-as-transport with host allowlist and private-IP DNS refusal (LIBRARIAN_RETIRED_20260927 transport note).
doctrine.never_fake: Paywalled / gone / illegible becomes NAMED DEBT, never a silent gap: KNOWLEDGE_DEBT_attachment_rearing.json buy-back paths, ILLEGIBLE-OCR quarantine (Soviet patent 808856: hash-valid but unreadable), RETIRED banners with reason and date. A hash-valid file is not a readable file.

retention_classes.permanent_corpus: corpus/ shelves + memory/corpus (founding_law holds magna_carta_1215, amendment_19_nara as bytes): sha-ledgered, receipted, two-direction audited; deletion only by the two-condition rule (unclaimed AND byte-identical).
retention_classes.dated_archive: watch/inbox dated dirs + memory/runs: append-only, autosealed (rib.md.record.v1), never rewritten in place - amend by new row.
retention_classes.scratch_with_rent_due: temp dirs, %TMPDIR%, session caches: may exist only transiently; each visit either promotes it into a class above or reaps it. NEVER enters git (violated tonight: 4 staged temp-class files).

doctrine.cadence_proposal: Librarian run as PER-WAVE ritual (daily minimum), three steps: (1) python -m mag.holdings_audit both directions, verdict CLEAN or findings named; (2) widened receipt matching path+sha alongside arXiv token (operator WIDEN-GO 2026-09-30, HOLDINGS_AUDIT_DECISION.md) so non-arXiv holdings count; (3) cited-but-not-held sweep (extract_citations.py) over the wave's receipts feeding the acquisition queue at point-of-claim. Instrument diseases patched: confident-zero over invisible corpus (name the match key and scope in every zero report), duplicate detector reporting itself (disjoint walk + independent count before any deletion), our-own-UA 406 disease (the 406s were partly our header talking).
doctrine.one_line_law: No verdict=LANDED without the primary in holdings.
